function.name: close_ticket
function.description: This tool belongs to the ticketing system that is part of a company, which allows users to create, view, and manage support business tickets. Tool description: Close a ticket. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to be closed.

function.name: create_ticket
function.description: This tool belongs to the ticketing system that is part of a company, which allows users to create, view, and manage support business tickets. Tool description: Create a ticket in the system and queue it. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

description.description: Description of the ticket. Defaults to an empty string.

priority.description: Priority of the ticket, from 1 to 5. Defaults to 1. 5 is the highest priority.

function.name: edit_ticket
function.description: This tool belongs to the ticketing system that is part of a company, which allows users to create, view, and manage support business tickets. Tool description: Modify the details of an existing ticket. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to be changed.

updates.description: Dictionary containing the fields to be updated.

function.name: get_ticket
function.description: This tool belongs to the ticketing system that is part of a company, which allows users to create, view, and manage support business tickets. Tool description: Get a specific ticket by its ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to retrieve.

function.name: get_user_tickets
function.description: This tool belongs to the ticketing system that is part of a company, which allows users to create, view, and manage support business tickets. Tool description: Get all tickets created by the current user, optionally filtered by status. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: Status to filter tickets by. If None, return all tickets.

function.name: logout
function.description: This tool belongs to the ticketing system that is part of a company, which allows users to create, view, and manage support business tickets. Tool description: Log out the current user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

success.description: True if logout was successful, False otherwise.

function.name: resolve_ticket
function.description: This tool belongs to the ticketing system that is part of a company, which allows users to create, view, and manage support business tickets. Tool description: Resolve a ticket with a resolution. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to be resolved.

function.name: ticket_get_login_status
function.description: This tool belongs to the ticketing system that is part of a company, which allows users to create, view, and manage support business tickets. Tool description: Get the login status of the currently authenticated user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
